symbols_and_definitions: C_N=native protein concentration; k_d=denaturation rate constant; t=time
symbol_units: C_N: mass/volume; k_d: s^-1; t: s
limitations: No grass-specific fitted parameter set identified.

symbols_and_definitions: C=solubilized concentration; C_inf=asymptote; C_0=initial concentration; k_s=rate constant
symbol_units: C values: consistent; k_s: s^-1; t: s
limitations: Must not be used until fitted to time-resolved green-biomass data.

symbols_and_definitions: k=rate constant; A=pre-exponential factor; E_a=activation energy; R=gas constant; T=absolute temperature
symbol_units: k: model-dependent; A: same as k; E_a: J/mol; R: J/(mol K); T: K
limitations: A and E_a must be source-reported or fitted from valid data; no values are assumed.

symbols_and_definitions: v=rate; V_max=maximum rate; S=substrate concentration; K_m=Michaelis constant
symbol_units: v and V_max: concentration/time; S and K_m: concentration
limitations: Heterogeneous cell-wall hydrolysis often violates homogeneous single-substrate assumptions.

symbols_and_definitions: I=inhibitor concentration; K_i=inhibition constant; other symbols as above
applicability: Only when competitive inhibition is demonstrated
limitations: Do not use unless source identifies inhibitor and reports/fits K_i.

symbol_units: E_active: activity or concentration; k_deact: s^-1; t: s
applicability: Candidate when first-order loss is supported
limitations: Requires measured residual activity versus time and temperature.

applicability: Use only below denaturation transition or with deactivation coupling
limitations: Simple Arrhenius behavior may fail near enzyme denaturation temperatures.
